before.requirement: Preserve a boundary marker before retained text while removing a marker before a stripped control.
before.reason: The old STRIPCC condition also removes negative markers, so this behavior was not supported by the before implementation.

after.requirement: With CHARBOUND and STRIPCC, retain boundary markers for surviving text and remove the marker immediately before a stripped control.
after.reason: The changed condition and marker removal support this behavior. The harness passes STRIPCC to the direct normalizer and CHARBOUND to some map calls, but never visibly passes both together. The missing flag definitions and map implementation prevent a definitive reachability assessment.

claims.reason: The before normalizer stripped negative markers; the after normalizer can retain them and conditionally remove a marker before a stripped control. The same old harness is assessed on both sides.
missing_information: The definitions of UTF8PROC_CHARBOUND and UTF8PROC_STRIPCC in utf8proc.h.

after.reason: The relevant branch structure remains, and the harness still pairs direct NLF2LS calls with STRIPCC. The same missing flag and mapping facts prevent a conclusive assessment.
